svg.title: Do predictive intervals cover complete economic truth?

cc:Work.dc:title: Do predictive intervals cover complete economic truth?
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Day-180 prospective forecasts • Deliberately misspecified stress generators Error bars: 95% percentile-bootstrap intervals, resampling whole worlds rather than correlated forecasts. Nominal 80%/95% lines are references, not validated guarantees. This is a small stress check, not Bayesian simulation-based calibration.
